summary: WF International Limited, a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into a September 10, 2026 Share Purchase Agreement with certain purchasers for a registered direct offering of 5,000,000 ordinary shares at $1.10 per share, roughly $5.5 million gross. The offering was made under an effective Form F-3 shelf registration statement and a September 10 prospectus supplement. Expected closing is September 14, 2026, with proceeds for general corporate purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown rather than a special situation; watch for dilution and post-closing trading pressure.
